-- Step 1: Create the summary table
CREATE TABLE center_performance_live (
    center_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    transplant_count INTEGER,
    avg_egs_score REAL
);

-- Step 2: Populate with current completed matches data

SELECT ar.tx_cen_code, COUNT(*) as cnt, AVG(re.egs_val) as avg_egs
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN administrative_and_review ar ON tm.match_rec_registry = ar.adm_rev_registry
LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re ON tm.match_rec_registry = re.risk_eval_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY ar.tx_cen_code;

-- Step 3: Create the trigger function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_update_center_performance()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    -- When a match is completed, update or insert into center_performance_live
    INSERT INTO center_performance_live (center_id, transplant_count, avg_egs_score)
    VALUES (NEW.tx_cen_code, 1, NEW.egs_val)
    ON CONFLICT (center_id) DO UPDATE SET
        transplant_count = center_performance_live.transplant_count + 1,
        avg_egs_score = (
            SELECT AVG(re.egs_val)
            FROM transplant_matching tm2
            JOIN administrative_and_review ar2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = ar2.adm_rev_registry
            LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = re2.risk_eval_registry
            WHERE ar2.tx_cen_code = center_performance_live.center_id
              AND tm2.match_status = 'Completed'
        );
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

-- Step 4: Create the trigger on administrative_and_review table
-- We need tx_cen_code from admin table and egs_val needs to be available
-- Actually, let's create trigger on transplant_matching joined with admin... 
-- Since triggers work on single tables, let's use administrative_and_review
-- But we need EGS which is in risk_evaluation. Let me rethink.

-- The trigger should fire when a match status changes to Completed.
-- Best approach: trigger on transplant_matching, but we need tx_cen_code.
-- We can look it up via the join in the trigger function.

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_update_center_performance ON transplant_matching;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS fn_update_center_performance();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_update_center_performance()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
    v_tx_cen_code TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Only act on INSERT or UPDATE to 'Completed'
    IF (TG_OP = 'UPDATE') THEN
        IF OLD.match_status = 'Completed' OR NEW.match_status != 'Completed' THEN
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    
    -- Get the center code by joining through administrative_and_review
    SELECT ar.tx_cen_code INTO v_tx_cen_code
    FROM administrative_and_review ar
    WHERE ar.adm_rev_registry = NEW.match_rec_registry;
    
    IF v_tx_cen_code IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    
    -- Get EGS value if available
    DECLARE
        v_egs REAL;
    BEGIN
        SELECT re.egs_val INTO v_egs
        FROM risk_evaluation re
        WHERE re.risk_eval_registry = NEW.match_rec_registry;
        
        INSERT INTO center_performance_live (center_id, transplant_count, avg_egs_score)
        VALUES (v_tx_cen_code, 1, v_egs)
        ON CONFLICT (center_id) DO UPDATE SET
            transplant_count = center_performance_live.transplant_count + 1,
            avg_egs_score = (
                SELECT AVG(re2.egs_val)
                FROM transplant_matching tm2
                JOIN administrative_and_review ar2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = ar2.adm_rev_registry
                LEFT JOIN risk_evaluation re2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = re2.risk_eval_registry
                WHERE ar2.tx_cen_code = center_performance_live.center_id
                  AND tm2.match_status = 'Completed'
            );
    END;
    
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trg_update_center_performance
AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF match_status ON transplant_matching
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN (OLD.match_status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.match_status)
EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_update_center_performance();
